author: By: Market News Video
title: Noteworthy ACOR, GPRO, AAPL
text: Looking at options trading activity among there is noteworthy activity today in Acorda Therapeutics Inc (ACOR), where a total volume of 10,115 contracts has been traded thus far today, a contract volume which is representative of approximately 1.0 million underlying shares (given that every 1 contract represents 100 underlying shares). That number works out to 141.7% of ACOR's average daily trading volume over the past month, of 713,930 shares..
